Maximum capacity (Emax) 10 kg up to and including 150 kg
Minimum dead load 0 kg
Accuracy Class C
Rated Output 2 mV/V
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) ≤ 7500
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / Vmin		 24000
Input impedance 415 Ω ± 15 Ω
